headline: Grok Draws 3 Copyright Suits Over AI Training With Books
claim: AI companies trained models on pirated books without authors' consent or payment.
notes: published 2026-11-06 (page date read via WebFetch). Three copyright suits by two publishers and a group of authors over books allegedly pirated to train the Grok model. Allegations only; no ruling yet. Defendant names not confirmed from the page excerpt. Other coverage (RuntimeWire, dated 2026-11-10) gives filing date 2026-11-04 and names a defendant entity that could not be confirmed, so it is not logged.

headline: BloombergNEF: Data center gas plants to increase US power emissions 10%
claim: The data center buildout raises US power-sector emissions.
notes: published 2026-11-11 (page date read via WebFetch). Relays a BloombergNEF report: on-site gas plants planned for US data centers (181 GW announced) could add about 10% to 2025 US power-sector emissions (about 345 million tonnes CO2e a year at assumed operating rates). Forecast, not a measurement; the report does not say how much capacity is permitted or financed. Other coverage says Bloomberg Philanthropies commissioned it; this article does not say. Bloomberg's own page returned 403, not read.
